We need to determine number of aromatic carbon atoms in the compound. But we have no description of compound. Possibly the sample is the one at hand, maybe we need to get NMR spectra to infer aromatic carbons. Could use carbon_nmr_spectra to get 13C NMR, then count aromatic carbon signals. But we don't know the compound. Could also retrieve typical aromatic carbon shift ranges, but need specific compound.

Probably the environment has a sample loaded; we can request carbon NMR. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool.
